editorial_intro: This week brings a fresh wave of Indian content to streaming platforms, including thrilling series like 'Suryaa: Ant se Aarambh Tak' and 'Pratap', alongside exciting films such as 'Itllu Arjuna' and 'Blind Game'. Don't miss out on these engaging stories that reflect diverse themes and captivating performances.

picks.title: Pratap
picks.synopsis: Pratap is an upcoming Indian Hindi-language action drama film written and directed by Sachin Saraf. The film stars Amit Sadh in the titular role, alongside Esha Deol, Seema Biswas, Tigmanshu Dhulia and Milind Gunaji.
picks.why_watch: With its fast-paced narrative and unexpected twists, 'Pratap' promises to keep you on the edge of your seat, making it a must-watch for thriller enthusiasts.

picks.title: Blind Game
picks.synopsis: Blind Game is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller film directed by Sangeeth Sivan and produced by Dinesh Mukut and Anuj Sharma under the banner of Soham Rockstar Entertainment. It stars Arjun Rampal, Priyamani and Rohit Chandel in lead roles.
picks.why_watch: With its gripping storyline and intense performances, 'Blind Game' is a thrilling ride that will keep you guessing until the very end.

picks.title: Jailer 2
picks.synopsis: Jailer 2 is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. It was produced by Kalanithi Maran through Sun Pictures.
picks.why_watch: Fans of action-packed cinema will love this sequel, which promises even more thrilling sequences and emotional depth than its predecessor.

picks.title: Daayra
picks.synopsis: Daayra (transl. Circle) is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller film co-written and directed by Meghna Gulzar.
picks.why_watch: This film is a poignant exploration of gender roles and the pursuit of passion, making it a must-watch for those who appreciate strong female narratives.
